summary: Frontend-only smoke test for Cris du Coeur static site executed at desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844. 26/27 checks passed. Hero renders and CTA scrolls, all navbar links scroll to their sections, hero rotation dots work, impact stats visible, manifesto/news/video iframe/annual-report all render, donation frequency toggles and amount buttons update submit label (e.g., 'Je donne 50€' -> 'Je donne 100€'), submit shows a success toast, footer and footer-donate-button work, mobile menu opens and shows nav links.
passed: hero-section renders with background and headline
hero-dot rotation changes slides (dot-2 clickable, downstream headline resolved)
video-play-button swaps to video-iframe on click
footer visible and footer-donate-button scrolls back to donation section
mobile-menu-toggle opens mobile-menu at 390x844 with nav links + Faire un don CTA

failed.issue: First read of hero-headline text_content timed out on initial render; hero rotation itself works (dot-2 clickable, subsequent flows verified). Likely due to animation entrance delay before headline attaches with data-testid.
failed.evidence: Locator [data-testid="hero-headline"] timed out once on load; all subsequent hero interactions succeeded.

notes: Per request, backend/payment intentionally not real; donation submit only triggers a toast, which was verified. No console errors observed impacting flows.
